data.how_to_apply: Applicants can be undergraduate, Master's, Ph.D. full- or part-time students, of computer science or related fields, with or without previous experience as volunteers. Every student volunteer will receive a complimentary conference registration, free lunches and refreshments during breaks, and student volunteer garments. To apply, fill out the form on the provided link.
